ADR 0109: registered typed writers and real PNG/WAV recording execute. Built-in AVI/MJPEG still needs RIFF video/audio interleaving/index over the existing JPEG encoder; OGV requires packaged Theora/Vorbis encoding and Ogg muxing, beyond the current decoder. Enter those mechanisms in the next executable recording-codec slices; they are not exclusions or implemented by generic hooks.

ADR 0109: built-in AVI/MJPEG needs a RIFF video/audio interleaver and index over the existing JPEG encoder. Its first executable encoder slice must consume typed video quality and PCM 16/32-bit settings; PNG/WAV uses fixed 32-bit PCM. No editor runtime is required for this dependency.

ADR 0109: first executable OGV encoder slice must supply native Theora/Vorbis encoding and Ogg muxing through the source/native package gates, with the three real quality/speed/keyframe controls. The existing Vorbis decoder cannot encode. Implementing that layer is authorized; no separate user command is required.

ADRs 0090/0109: the current host accepts explicit path/FPS. The first movie project/profile startup adapter must bind configured path/cadence and native presentation override with explicit-argument precedence before recording startup. That adapter is absent; these are not implemented by the explicit Run overloads and do not require a self-hosted editor.
